In other words, cognitive function does not predict frequency compressed speech recognition in listeners with normal hearing and normal cognition, but it is possible for individuals with normal cognitive functions to experience improvement or enhancement in their ability to recognize frequency compressed speech-in-noise through training and adaptation.
